package.description: Manage your iLok-activated software licenses and activations.

en-US.description: Manage your iLok-activated software licenses and activations.
en-US.longDescription: iLok License Manager manages iLok-enabled software licenses. It lets you activate and deactivate licenses to fit your workflow, whether to an iLok USB Smart Key, to a computer, or to the iLok Cloud where supported by the publisher, and move your licenses to where they are the most convenient for you.
en-US.name: iLok License Manager

zh-CN.description: 管理您的 iLok 激活的软件许可证和激活。
zh-CN.longDescription: iLok License Manager 用于管理支持 iLok 的软件许可证。您可以根据工作流程将许可证激活或停用到 iLok USB 智能锁、计算机或发行商支持的 iLok Cloud，并将许可证移动到对您最方便的位置。
